# Sobelow review for the non-Phoenix library

Sobelow 0.15.0 scans the complete source tree in `mix check`. Its 24 reported
findings are all low-confidence `Traversal.FileModule` warnings. The exact
file, line, operation and variable set is retained in `sobelow-reviewed.json`.
`tools/check_sobelow.exs` runs Sobelow, refuses every medium/high finding,
refuses a changed scanner version, and refuses any added, removed or changed
low-confidence finding until this review is revisited. The gate prints the
reviewed count; it does not report a clean security scan or skip the tool.

`IoT.ReceiptRun` reads the library's own model, the explicitly selected Maude
executable and its adjacent prelude. It creates a random directory under the
OS temporary root with mode 0700, writes pinned model/checker bytes there,
reads them back for identity checks and removes that directory. The directory
and member names are generated by the library, not copied from a rule, model
output or network response.

`Verification.SearchRun` reads the executable path explicitly supplied by the
host after checking it is an existing regular file. Its model snapshot uses a
random mode-0700 temporary directory and a fixed filename. Its normal and
caller-loss cleanup use that generated directory. The query fields cannot
enter a filesystem path. These uses do not traverse a path derived from an
untrusted HTTP request; the embedding host remains responsible for choosing
the executable and authorizing model bytes.

This disposition is limited to the exact recorded lines and current source
flow. Any change to path provenance, temporary-directory construction or
scanner behavior requires another review.
